name: @infoschematics/is-infoschematics
description: A self-describing authored Infoschematic of the Infoschematics package architecture.

examples.title: Structure and presentation combined in one Infoschematic

scripts.check: infoschematics render infoschematic.yaml --output /dev/null && infoschematics render overview.yaml --output /dev/null
scripts.render: infoschematics render infoschematic.yaml --output infoschematic.svg && infoschematics render overview.yaml --output overview.svg
